name: @samvardiq/communication-orchestration
description: Governed WhatsApp appointment-booking orchestration (CLINIC-W2B). Owns communication-channel/conversation persistence, the Meta webhook adapter, the provider-neutral AI interpretation boundary, and the deterministic booking state machine. Does not own Samvardiq authentication (see ADR-IDENTITY-002) or any W1B clinic-CMS logic (reused, never duplicated).

scripts.build:deps: npm run build --prefix ../marketing-intelligence && npm run build --prefix ../approval-governance && npm run build --prefix ../data-foundation && npm run build --prefix ../identity-access && npm run build --prefix ../clinic-cms-connector && npm run build --prefix ../application-services
